description: This file defines an abstract generic class AbstractEventRegistry for handling registration and parsing of Event objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages JSON parsing strategies and resolves event types from JSON data.

classes.name: AbstractEventRegistry
classes.description: Abstract class for managing Event registration and JSON parsing strategies, deprecated in the project.

methods.name: AbstractEventRegistry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the registry with parsing strategies.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the event type from a JsonObject, throws exception if missing.
